messages.content: Help me prepare a release checklist for our desktop app. Keep it focused on what we can verify today.

## Release checklist

Start with the user journeys that matter most, then verify the packaged app.

| Area | Check | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chat | Send a message and inspect tool results | Ready |
| Workspace | Open files and preview an artifact | Ready |
| Settings | Confirm provider and model selection | Ready |
| Packaging | Launch a clean install on each platform | Pending |

### Next steps

1. Run the focused tests and TypeScript checks.
2. Capture the chat flow in light and dark mode.
3. Record platform checks in the release notes.

The checklist is ready for review. Platform acceptance remains a separate step.
